blocks.content: The group by transformation allows you to group rows that share the same values in one or more fields. It's similar to the SQL `GROUP BY` clause. Use this when you need to aggregate data based on one or more fields, such as grouping by a specific category or region.
To use this transformation, open an existing panel in edit mode on your dashboard.
In the query editor sidebar, click the plus sign next to the **Transformations** section.

blocks.reftarget: div[data-testid='data-testid New transform Group by'] button

blocks.content: Select **Group by** on the dropdown of the field(s) you want to group by. To calculate a value for the other fields and apply it to each group, select **Calculate** and a calculation type on the dropdown of the field(s) you want to calculate.

steps.description: Configure the grouping and calculations in this editor, then click anywhere here when you're done.

blocks.content: Click **Save**, add an optional description of your changes, and click **Save** again.

steps.description: Enter a description of your changes if you want and then click Save.

blocks.content:
The transformation is applied automatically. If it doesn't refresh, click **Refresh** on the panel to verify the visualization looks as intended.

In the next milestone, you'll filter your data by specific values.
